experience.title: Research Fellow
experience.collaborators: Emmanouil Koukoumidis, Panos Achlioptas, Shang Hong Sim
details: Building a benchmark for semantic risk reasoning that evaluates models' ability to discriminate risk type, assess severity, and justify rationales from text.
Operationalizing a comprehensive risk taxonomy and engineering a high-quality contrastive dataset to stress-test model safety and alignment.

experience.title: Research Lead & Mentor
details: Recruited and led a 12-person team to generate complex ground-truth datasets for agent benchmarking. Designed consensus protocols to resolve conflicting domain priorities (Data Science vs. ML) to ensure alignment and rigor. Co-authored paper accepted to EMNLP 2024.
Advised 50+ interdisciplinary teams through 0-to-1 development of user-centered systems in graduate level project-based classes.

experience.title: Research Intern
details: Designed a novel structured user profiling framework that synthesizes interaction data with social science theory to create robust, interpretable user representations, enabling inference-time personalized steering.

Engineered a novel ecologically valid evaluation pipeline to generate ground-truth test cases for auditing agent alignment and validated system effectiveness via a robust auditing protocol using 90 days of real user communication data across 20 participants. Paper and Patent currently under review.

experience.title: Research Intern
experience.collaborators: Steven Drucker, Bongshin Lee, Dave Brown
details: Led foundational research on using generative AI for end-to-end data analysis and decision making.

Designed and ran studies with industry experienced data analysts to evaluate how they understand, trust, and verify AI-generated analyses, identifying failure modes and verification strategies. Co-authored paper accepted to CHI 2024.

experience.title: Data Science and User Research Intern
experience.collaborators: Mantas Lilis, Joshua Noble, Justin Lawyer
details: Improved the ML model debugging experience for data scientists by leading research and designing product guided workflows for TruEra ML Model Diagnostics.
Identified the top pain points in real debugging practice and prioritized fixes, driving 0 to 1 product exploration and shaped the roadmap.
